title.zh: 新版轴对称各向异性 Picard 平衡

summary: Iterate a caller-provided anisotropic pressure closure against the current poloidal field, cylindrical pressure force and a dense Green flux update, then recompute and check the returned terminal state.

identity.relation: vacuum flux, dense cell-current Green response and caller pressure closure to a bounded anisotropic axisymmetric equilibrium state
identity.direction: R-Z grid, psi_vac, g_psi, pressure_closure and controls -> final psi, magnetic/pressure/force fields, cell currents and iteration diagnostics
identity.definition: Starting at a copy of psi_vac, derive B_R/B_Z/B from psi, gate minimum field, call pressure_closure(B,psi), broadcast scalar pressures or require exact grid shapes, evaluate cylindrical div(P), mask inactive J_phi, and apply a flux-relaxed Green update. Stop when the step's relative psi change reaches tol or maxiter is exhausted; then rederive and gate the field before calling the terminal closure and force, then apply firehose and parallel-force checks.
identity.model: bounded axisymmetric gyrotropic pressure Picard composition with externally supplied pressure closure
identity.geometry: rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid with at least three nodes per axis
identity.coordinates: all state arrays indexed [Z,R]; dense Green axes use C-order field points and cell currents
identity.boundary: Nonnegative R including an axis is allowed; magnetic field must stay above minimum_field in iteration and terminal states. The graph does not solve a separate free boundary.
assumptions: pressure_closure is a caller-owned scientific callable that interprets each current psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad and returns physically meaningful p_parallel and p_perpendicular in Pa.
g_psi maps cell currents in A to psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad in the declared order; no 2*pi conversion occurs inside the graph.
The graph's plasma_mask=True cells are active; inactive current is zeroed before feedback, while the force Operator itself uses the mask only for its error metric.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative rectilinear R, strictly increasing radial axis and at least three columns; same shape as z_grid and psi_vac.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear Z with strictly increasing axial axis and at least three rows; same shape as r_grid and psi_vac.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum or externally supplied initial psi=R A_phi.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as grid; the graph copies it and the field Operator validates its finite values.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.constraints: Rows/columns follow [Z,R] C order; exact square shape and finite values.

inputs.name: pressure_closure
inputs.description: Caller pressure relation evaluated against each current field and psi=R A_phi.
inputs.units: output pressure Pa; input B T and psi Wb/rad
inputs.constraints: Returns nonnegative finite p_parallel and p_perpendicular as scalars or exact grid arrays; other mapping keys are retained in closure_state.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.constraints: At least one update; nonconvergence returns the last state with converged=false.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Previous-flux retention weight passed to the Green update.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax < 1; this is flux rather than current relaxation.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Fixed active-cell boolean array or dynamic callable evaluated from each B,psi state.
inputs.constraints: When omitted, all cells are active; False cells have J_phi set to zero before Green feedback.

inputs.name: minimum_field
inputs.description: Required lower bound on the current and returned field magnitude.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; field values below it raise FloatingPointError before pressure_closure runs.

inputs.name: minimum_firehose_margin
inputs.description: Lower bound on active-cell firehose/tension margin at the terminal state.
inputs.constraints: Active-cell margins at or below this value raise FloatingPointError at terminal evaluation.

inputs.name: compatibility_tol
inputs.description: Upper bound on the terminal active-domain parallel-force error when strict checking is enabled.

inputs.name: strict_compatibility
inputs.description: Whether terminal parallel-force incompatibility is rejected.
inputs.constraints: When false, return the error diagnostic without applying the compatibility_tol failure gate.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Last psi=R A_phi state after one or more bounded Picard updates.
outputs.constraints: The terminal field, closure and force outputs are recomputed on this same state.

outputs.name: plasma_cell_currents
outputs.description: Terminal masked J_phi times absolute first-spacing cell area.
outputs.constraints: Recomputed at the returned psi; may differ from the last step's raw currents.

outputs.name: J_phi
outputs.constraints: Zeroed outside the terminal active mask.

outputs.name: B_R
outputs.constraints: Derived from returned psi by the bound field Operator.

outputs.name: B_Z
outputs.constraints: Derived from returned psi by the bound field Operator.

outputs.name: B
outputs.constraints: Minimum-field gate is rechecked after terminal recomputation.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Terminal closure parallel pressure after scalar broadcast or grid validation.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Terminal closure perpendicular pressure after scalar broadcast or grid validation.

outputs.name: parallel_force
outputs.description: Terminal pressure force projected along the field.
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic; not used to rewrite psi.

outputs.name: force_R
outputs.constraints: From the bound anisotropic force Operator.

outputs.name: force_Z
outputs.constraints: From the bound anisotropic force Operator.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether a step relative_psi_change reached tol within maxiter.
outputs.constraints: False at the bound is returned, not raised solely for nonconvergence.

outputs.name: relative_psi_change
outputs.constraints: Uses the Picard update Operator's norm convention.

outputs.name: parallel_force_error
outputs.constraints: Compatibility gate uses this value only when strict_compatibility is true.

outputs.name: closure_state
outputs.description: Final caller closure mapping with normalized pressure fields.
outputs.constraints: Additional caller fields are retained; p_parallel and p_perpendicular are grid arrays.

outputs.name: firehose_margin
outputs.constraints: Checked only on terminal active cells against minimum_firehose_margin.

outputs.name: iteration_history
outputs.description: One mapping of relative psi/current changes for each executed step.
outputs.constraints: Each item contains iteration, relative_psi_change and relative_current_change.

preconditions: A caller supplies a valid gyrotropic pressure_closure for each state and a physically aligned dense Green response.
The R-Z grid and every bound Operator's inputs satisfy their respective contracts.
The poloidal field remains above minimum_field during iteration and terminal reevaluation.
supported: Bounded current-source branch of axisymmetric anisotropic pressure Picard iteration with a caller-selected closure and active-cell policy.
excluded: A built-in pressure closure or automatic choice of anisotropic model.
Free-boundary conductor response, kinetic end-loss closure or non-axisymmetric equilibrium.
A guarantee of convergence, physical stability or compatibility for arbitrary caller closures.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError/TypeError for missing or invalid grid, Green matrix, controls, pressure_closure or mask; invalid closure mapping/pressure values, wrong mask shape and dependency input failures propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError before pressure_closure when an iteration or terminal field is below minimum_field, or when the terminal active firehose margin is at/below its limit; strict parallel-force incompatibility raises ValueError. Callback and dependency failures otherwise propagate without fallback.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: After maxiter steps, returns the last state with converged=false and the iteration history; there is no automatic retry or failure_reason field.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping is returned after an exception. Bounded nonconvergence is a complete last-state result, not an exception.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel TaskGraph mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 anisotropic Picard composition and direct graph tests; historical review labels are development provenance, not expert recognition of this version.
source_kinds: saved L1 TaskGraph contract and implementation

example.description: A zero Green response with an isotropic linear radial pressure performs one analytic current step and returns the unchanged vacuum flux.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_axisymmetric_anisotropic_picard
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.2, 0.6, 5), np.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, 5))
pressure = 3.0 + r_grid
result = solve_axisymmetric_anisotropic_picard(r_grid=r_grid, z_grid=z_grid, psi_vac=r_grid**2, g_psi=np.zeros((25,25)), pressure_closure=lambda _b,_psi: {'p_parallel': pressure, 'p_perpendicular': pressure}, maxiter=1, tol=1e-12, relax=0.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'], r_grid**2)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['J_phi'], 0.5, rtol=2e-13, atol=2e-13)
assert result['converged'] and result['iterations'] == 1
example.expected: One converged step with unchanged vacuum flux and terminal toroidal current density 0.5 A/m^2 on the small grid.

scope: Final field and closure are recomputed at the returned psi, with the terminal minimum-field gate before the caller closure.
Dynamic inactive mask is applied before Green feedback and scalar pressures broadcast unchanged.

A manufactured P4 circular-filament vacuum field and mirror Green current feed the real graph with strict compatibility enabled; the off-source returned field matches the direct filament field and the nonzero plasma flux increment matches its source current.
Wrong pressure shape, missing closure and invalid controls fail closed.
Manufactured isotropic linear pressure produces analytic J_phi and terminal cell currents.
Terminal firehose, compatibility and minimum-field checks.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct graph and leaf regressions cover selected small-grid feedback, masks, terminal recomputation, one off-source circular-filament/mirror-Green composition and failure paths; they do not prove real-device convergence, physical applicability of arbitrary caller closures, resolved self-fields or expert recognition.
known_limitations: The caller-provided pressure closure is not independently standardized by this graph and must interpret psi=R A_phi; prior clients treating the Wb label as complete linked flux need a scientific compatibility review.
The returned cell currents are recomputed from the terminal force, not merely copied from the last step.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.

nodes.description: Copy psi_vac and initialize previous unrelaxed currents to zeros.
Derive poloidal magnetic components and magnitude on each current psi, including terminal reevaluation.
Reject an iteration or terminal field below minimum_field before calling the pressure closure.
Invoke the caller-owned pressure_closure(B,psi) without substituting a built-in physical relation.
Broadcast scalar pressures or validate exact grid arrays, require nonnegative finite values, and evaluate the fixed or dynamic active-cell selector.
Evaluate cylindrical div(P), J_phi and force/firehose diagnostics; active_mask selects the error metric but does not mask J_phi here.
Set J_phi to zero outside the caller-selected active region before feedback.
Convert masked current density to raw cell currents, apply the dense Green matrix and relax flux.
Count steps, accumulate both relative changes, stop at tol or maxiter and retain next psi/current state.
After the terminal field has passed the minimum-field gate, assemble pressure/force outputs, recompute masked cell currents and apply firehose and optional parallel-force gates.

execution.ordering: Validate controls and geometry; for each step derive field, gate minimum B, call/normalize closure, select active cells, compute force, mask J_phi, update flux and record changes. After stopping, derive and gate the final field before closure and force, then mask current and apply firehose and compatibility gates before returning.
branches: A fixed mask, dynamic mask or all-active default is selected by the caller's plasma_mask port.
At maxiter with relative_psi_change above tol, return converged=false after terminal checks.
strict_compatibility=false returns an above-threshold parallel-force error without the compatibility ValueError.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns evolving psi, previous raw currents, iteration count and history; the caller owns grid, Green matrix, pressure_closure and mask policy.
execution.failure_propagation: Invalid inputs and dependency/callback failures abort the call. Minimum-field, terminal firehose and strict parallel-force gates raise as documented; nonconvergence alone returns the last state.

feedback.state: psi, previous raw cell currents, relative flux/current changes and iteration count
feedback.initialization: psi is a copy of psi_vac, previous currents are zeros, relative change is initially infinite and count is zero.
feedback.update_order: Derive field and current closure on current psi, perform one Green flux step, append diagnostics, assign psi_next and raw currents, then test relative_psi_change against tol.
feedback.continue_when: relative_psi_change > tol and executed count < maxiter
feedback.stop_when: relative_psi_change <= tol or executed count reaches maxiter
feedback.nonconvergence: Recompute and gate terminal fields, then return converged=false with the last state and history; no retry is hidden.
